📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Tutte le novità per la Supercoppa Italiana dal 2027 al 2030: si riparte dalla gara secca, ma resta l'opzione estero.

In a recent development, la Lega Calcio Serie A ha ufficialmente approvato e reso pubblico il bando per i diritti audiovisivi della Supercoppa Italiana sul territorio italiano per il triennio 2027/28, 2028/29 e 2029/30, disegnando un quadro che lega strettamente aspetti sportivi e ritorni economici. Il primo cambiamento strutturale è la separazione della Supercoppa dalla Coppa Italia nella vendita dei diritti, una scelta che dà alla competizione un percorso commerciale autonomo per i prossimi tre anni.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Per chi si aggiudicherà i diritti televisivi, la novità principale è la possibilità esclusiva di acquistare anche il pacchetto di title sponsorship legato al torneo. Non è fissato un prezzo minimo di partenza: le emittenti dovranno formulare una propria offerta economica, indicando anche un corrispettivo aggiuntivo in caso di formula a quattro squadre. Chi otterrà questo abbinamento potrà legare il proprio nome alla competizione e al premio per il migliore in campo, oltre a ottenere visibilità a bordocampo, sul trofeo e sulla patch applicata alla manica destra delle maglie delle squadre partecipanti. Sul fronte della trasmissione, le eventuali semifinali potranno andare in onda anche a pagamento, mentre per la finale restano fermi gli obblighi di diffusione in chiaro previsti dalla normativa sugli eventi di particolare rilevanza sociale.

Sul piano del calendario, la Lega cercherà un'intesa con il licenziatario per stabilire il periodo di svolgimento del torneo, ma si riserva comunque l'ultima parola se non si dovesse raggiungere un accordo. Come criterio base il bando riporta la Supercoppa alla formula tradizionale della gara secca tra la vincitrice del campionato e quella della Coppa Italia, fissando un prezzo minimo di 8 milioni di euro a stagione (24 milioni complessivi nel triennio). Resta però aperta la strada della Final Four: la Lega può scegliere a propria discrezione di attivarla in una o più stagioni del bando, con le prime due classificate in campionato e le due finaliste di Coppa Italia (e l'eventuale ripescaggio di terza e quarta in Serie A), incassando in quel caso 7 milioni di euro in più per ciascuna edizione. A pesare sulla decisione tra finale a due o a quattro sarà soprattutto la sede, dato che resta la possibilità di giocare sia in Italia sia all'estero.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Ce jeudi soir, l'équipe de France défie l'Italie à San Siro sans son capitaine Kylian Mbappé. Touché par une gêne musculaire aux ischio-jambiers, l'attaquant tricolore doit déclarer forfait pour ce choc au sommet de la Ligue des nations. Une immense frustration pour le joueur.

Recent findings suggest that C'est un coup d'arrêt pour Kylian Mbappé en équipe de France. Alors que les Bleus affrontent la Nazionale ce jeudi 12 novembre à 20h45 sur la pelouse de San Siro, le capitaine tricolore est contraint de renoncer à cette prestigieuse affiche comptant pour la 5e journée du groupe A1 de la Ligue des nations. La sélection française, en tête de sa poule avec 10 points devant les Italiens (7 points), espérait pourtant pouvoir compter sur son leader offensif après le score de parité concédé au match aller en octobre au Stade de France (1-1). Un rendez-vous manqué de plus. Ce forfait face aux Transalpins constitue en effet le quatrième match consécutif manqué par l'attaquant du Real Madrid sous le maillot bleu.

In a recent development, L'alerte est intervenue mercredi matin lors de la préparation de la rencontre. L'attaquant vedette a ainsi manqué la séance d'entraînement collectif après avoir ressenti cette petite douleur. Face à cette gêne aux ischio-jambiers, le staff de l'équipe de France a refusé catégoriquement de prendre le moindre risque avec la condition physique de Kylian Mbappé au regard de la longueur de la saison. Une précaution prise par le staff alors que le joueur souhaitait disputer cette rencontre.

It has been revealed that présent en conférence de presse d'avant-match à Milan, le sélectionneur des Bleus Zinédine Zidane a officialisé la nouvelle, précisant que son capitaine n'était pas content de devoir renoncer à ce grand rendez-vous. Le technicien a détaillé avec franchise la situation de son joueur.

In a recent development, toutefois, malgré cette déception, Kylian Mbappé a tenu à rester impliqué aux côtés de ses partenaires. Contrairement à Aurélien Tchouaméni et Marcus Thuram, invités à rentrer se soigner en club, le capitaine a fait le choix de rester avec le groupe tricolore en Italie. Une attitude saluée par Zinédine Zidane devant les journalistes.

Au-delà de la frustration du joueur, le sélectionneur a insisté sur la nécessité de protéger les organismes tout au long de l'exercice.

Industry observers note that pour compenser les multiples absences offensives, le jeune joueur du PSG Senny Mayulu a été appelé en renfort de dernière minute. Une opportunité pour compenser les forfaits dans le secteur offensif à San Siro.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that libre de tout contrat depuis son départ de Manchester City en mai 2026, Pep Guardiola pourrait rapidement retrouver un banc prestigieux. La Fédération américaine de football (U.S. Soccer) a placé le technicien catalan en priorité absolue pour prendre les rênes de la sélection nationale, alors que Mauricio Pochettino se rapproche de Manchester United.

Sources indicate that un changement majeur se prépare outre-Atlantique. Le poste de sélectionneur des États-Unis va probablement se libérer en raison du départ imminent de Mauricio Pochettino vers Manchester United pour remplacer Michael Carrick. Selon les révélations de The Athletic, un accord verbal a été conclu ce mercredi 11 novembre 2026 entre le club mancunien et le technicien argentin, pendant que les dirigeants Omar Berrada et Jason Wilcox validaient à Monaco avec Sir Jim Ratcliffe le limogeage de Carrick.U.S. Soccer négocie désormais le départ de Pochettino avec Manchester United contre une indemnité de résiliation estimée à 10 millions de dollars, soit environ 7 millions de livres sterling.

Pour combler ce vide, les dirigeants américains ont de grandes ambitions. D'après The Athletic, la fédération américaine fait de Pep Guardiola sa priorité absolue pour succéder à Mauricio Pochettino. Le nom du technicien catalan se trouve déjà au centre de discussions en interne afin de déterminer la méthode pour le convaincre. Selon le journaliste Tom Bogert, l'instance prévoit d'initier la démarche par un appel direct au coach espagnol. Sans club depuis son départ de Manchester City en mai 2026, après dix années marquées par six titres de Premier League et une Ligue des champions, Guardiola avait déjà été approché par U.S. Soccer en 2024 puis avant la Coupe du monde 2022.

U.S. Soccer est prête à répondre aux exigences salariales très élevées du technicien catalan pour finaliser sa venue. Les décideurs américains savent également que Pep Guardiola possède une attache particulière avec les États-Unis, pour y avoir habité à New York pendant son année sabbatique en 2012 après son passage au FC Barcelone. Toutefois, convaincre l'ancien entraîneur des Cityzens reste un défi complexe. En juillet 2026, Guardiola avait ainsi décliné une offre de la fédération italienne après une rencontre à Barcelone avec Paolo Maldini et Leonardo, car il souhaitait impérativement respecter son année sabbatique à l'écart des terrains.

L'argument décisif de la sélection américaine pourrait ainsi venir d'un calendrier taillé sur mesure. En effet, ce projet permettrait à Pep Guardiola de prolonger son repos, le match amical de décembre contre la Jamaïque étant réservé aux joueurs locaux, ce qui repousserait ses débuts effectifs à mars 2027. En attendant l'concern de ce feuilleton, Mauricio Pochettino dirige actuellement l'équipe américaine en Géorgie. Les États-Unis disputent leur quart de finale de Ligue des nations de la Concacaf contre Haïti, le 14 novembre à Miami pour le match aller, puis le 17 novembre 2026 à Cincinnati pour le retour, avant le ralliement attendu de l'Argentin vers Manchester.

Recent findings suggest that manchester United a officialisé ce jeudi 12 novembre 2026, par l'intermédiaire d'un communiqué, le limogeage avec effet immédiat de son entraîneur Michael Carrick. Plongée dans une crise sportive historique, la direction mancunienne a décidé d'agir sans attendre la fin de la semaine pour redresser la situation.

Sources indicate that arrivé au centre d'entraînement de Carrington à 7h50 ce jeudi matin, Michael Carrick n'aura pas passé beaucoup de temps avec ses joueurs. Le technicien de 45 ans a définitivement quitté les installations du club vers 10h18 après avoir été notifié de son renvoi. Une matinée particulièrement expéditive pour l'Anglais. Michael Carrick a en effet été informé en personne de cette décision par le directeur général Omar Berrada et le directeur du football Jason Wilcox. Ce dénouement fait suite directe à un sommet crucial tenu la veille à Monaco entre Sir Jim Ratcliffe et la famille Glazer, réunis par visioconférence pour sceller définitivement le sort de leur manager.

Pour justifier ce choix fort, la direction mancunienne a publié un communiqué sans détour.

Recent findings suggest that le dernier match de Michael Carrick sur le banc s'est soldé par un match nul spectaculaire (4-4) arraché in extremis contre Aston Villa à Old Trafford dimanche 8 novembre 2026. Un ultime sursaut qui n'a pas suffi à sauver sa place. Manchester United pointe actuellement à une inquiétante 18e place de Premier League en position de relégable, avec un bilan de 8 points et une seule victoire en 10 journées, décrochée fin août face à Ipswich. C'est tout simplement le pire début de saison du club en 40 ans.

Pourtant, le redressement opéré par le technicien avait suscité de grands espoirs quelques mois plus tôt. Nommé sur le banc mancunien en janvier 2026 en succession de Rúben Amorim, Michael Carrick avait hissé l'équipe à la 3e place en remportant 12 de ses 17 derniers matches de la saison 2025-2026. Michael Carrick avait d'ailleurs prolongé son contrat au mois de mai 2026 à la suite de cette qualification en Ligue des champions, avant que la situation ne s'effondre en ce début d'exercice.

Dans son communiqué officiel, le club anglais a également précisé ses intentions pour la suite immédiate de la saison.

D'après les révélations de la presse européenne, Mauricio Pochettino fait figure de grand favori pour s'installer sur le banc et disposerait d'un accord verbal pour succéder à Michael Carrick. L'Argentin, actuellement sélectionneur des États-Unis, n'est toutefois pas encore officiellement nommé. Manchester United doit d'abord s'acquitter d'une clause libératoire estimée à près de 10 millions de dollars, soit environ 9 millions d'euros, afin de libérer le technicien de son contrat américain.

S'il venait à prendre les commandes de l'équipe première, Mauricio Pochettino deviendrait ainsi le 12e entraîneur de Manchester United depuis le départ de Sir Alex Ferguson en 2013. Un chantier colossal attend le futur manager. Le prochain match de Manchester United est programmé le dimanche 22 novembre 2026 à Anfield face à Liverpool pour le compte de la 11e journée de Premier League.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Moins de cinq mois après sa nomination à Crystal Palace, Pierre Sage a été officiellement démis de ses fonctions ce jeudi 12 novembre 2026.
  • Pierre Sage n'aura pas résisté au revers concédé à domicile contre Liverpool (1-3), le dimanche 8 novembre 2026 à Selhurst Park, signant une quatrième défaite de rang en championnat.
  • La situation n'était guère plus brillante sur la scène continentale.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Moins de cinq mois après sa nomination à Crystal Palace, Pierre Sage a été officiellement démis de ses fonctions ce jeudi 12 novembre 2026. L'entraîneur français de 47 ans paie un début de saison désastreux en Premier League, laissant le club londonien à la dernière place du championnat.

Pierre Sage n'aura pas résisté au revers concédé à domicile contre Liverpool (1-3), le dimanche 8 novembre 2026 à Selhurst Park, signant une quatrième défaite de rang en championnat. En dix journées de Premier League sous les ordres de Pierre Sage, le bilan comptable est accablant avec 7 défaites, 1 match nul et seulement 2 victoires, soit 7 petits points pris sur 30 possibles. Crystal Palace occupe ainsi la 20e et dernière place du classement, à deux longueurs du premier non-relégable. Une situation critique.

La situation n'était guère plus brillante sur la scène continentale. En Ligue Europa, les Eagles pointent au 21e rang de la phase de ligue avec une seule victoire en quatre rencontres. Au total, Pierre Sage n'aura dirigé que 16 matches sur le banc de Crystal Palace toutes compétitions confondues avant son licenciement.

Sur le terrain, la méthode du coach français n'a jamais fonctionné. L'application stricte d'un bloc haut a constamment exposé son arrière-garde, faisant de Crystal Palace la pire défense d'Angleterre avec 24 buts encaissés en 10 matches de championnat. Le mandat de Pierre Sage a notamment été marqué par une lourde défaite (5-0) subie en octobre 2026 face au rival historique Brighton. Un naufrage tactique.

Toutefois, l'effectif a également pâti des départs estivaux non compensés de Maxence Lacroix et Marc Guéhi en défense centrale, dans un contexte de recrutement restreint par une direction plus économe. La succession d'Oliver Glasner s'annonçait d'ailleurs périlleuse, l'Autrichien étant devenu l'idole des supporters après ses victoires en FA Cup et au Community Shield en 2025, puis en Ligue Conférence, avant de rejoindre Nottingham Forest.

Cette éviction intervient alors que Pierre Sage sortait d'une saison brillante au RC Lens, couronnée du titre de meilleur entraîneur de Ligue 1, d'une victoire en Coupe de France et d'une 2e place en championnat. Selon L'Équipe, le technicien pourrait rebondir sans tarder dans le Nord. Il figure parmi les pistes explorées par les dirigeants artésiens, aux côtés de Didier Digard et Thiago Motta, pour succéder à Yannick Cahuzac, limogé en début de semaine.

In a recent development, de son côté, Crystal Palace négocie activement avec l'entraîneur danois Thomas Frank pour reprendre l'équipe. Les Eagles tenteront de se relancer lors de leur prochain match, programmé le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 15h00 face à Coventry City à la Coventry Building Society Arena, pour le compte de la 11e journée de Premier League.

Invité dans le podcast Kampo animé par le journaliste Smaïl Bouabdellah, Thierry Henry s'est longuement livré sur les coulisses des Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024. L'ancien sélectionneur de l'équipe de France olympique a révélé la détermination totale de Michael Olise pour disputer le tournoi sous le maillot tricolore.

Sources indicate that en 2024 la confection de la liste pour les Jeux Olympiques de Paris avait rapidement viré au casse-tête pour le sélectionneur tricolore. Le tournoi olympique de football n'étant pas inscrit sur les dates officielles du calendrier de la FIFA, les clubs professionnels n'avaient aucune obligation légale de libérer leurs joueurs. Cette absence de contrainte réglementaire avait grandement compliqué la tâche de Thierry Henry pour composer son groupe. Face à ces nombreux refus, Michael Olise a adopté une démarche diamétralement opposée.

It has been revealed that L'attaquant a fait le forcing pour s'assurer une place dans le groupe olympique. Alors que Gareth Southgate souhaitait le convoquer avec les A de l'équipe d'Angleterre pour disputer l'Euro 2024, Michael Olise a écarté cette opportunité pour privilégier le maillot tricolore. Le joueur a ainsi multiplié les appels téléphoniques directs avec le sélectionneur français. Dans le podcast Kampo animé par Smaïl Bouabdellah, Thierry Henry a détaillé cette insistance quotidienne : « Michael, il m’appelait tous les jours pour aller aux JO, alors qu’il y avait l’équipe d’Angleterre qui le voulait pour aller au Championnat d’Europe avec les A. Il aurait pu aller à l’Euro avec l’Angleterre. Mais il m’appelait tous les jours. Son envie de jouer pour l’équipe de France était extraordinaire. Moi, je n’ai convaincu personne. ».

Industry observers note that né à Londres en 2001 d'un père nigérian et d'une mère franco-algérienne, Michael Olise disposait sur le plan sportif de plusieurs options internationales. L'attaquant était éligible pour quatre sélections nationales différentes : la France, l'Angleterre, le Nigeria et l'Algérie. Toutefois, Michael Olise a toujours accordé sa préférence absolue à l'équipe de France. Au-delà des approches anglaises, le joueur a fait preuve d'une fermeté totale au moment de quitter Crystal Palace pour rejoindre l'Allemagne.

Recent findings suggest that recruté par le Bayern Munich pour 53 millions d'euros selon Foot Mercato, et plus de 60 millions d'euros d'après d'autres sources, il a imposé sa participation aux Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024. Le joueur a ainsi pris le risque de se heurter à sa nouvelle direction bavaroise pour défendre les couleurs tricolores. Thierry Henry a salué cette prise de position au micro de Smaïl Bouabdellah : « Michael Olise aime l’équipe de France depuis qu’il est petit. Certains joueurs ne voulaient pas venir. Pas de problème, je n’en veux à personne. Mais un mec de ce calibre est venu, alors qu’il y avait le risque de s’embrouiller avec son nouveau club. Il m’a dit: 'Où je vais, je vais dire à mon club que je vais aux Jeux olympiques, c’est tout.’ On parle de Michael Olise. Mon respect pour lui est énorme. ».

Recent findings suggest that sur le terrain, ce choix a porté ses fruits tout au long de la compétition estivale. Titulaire lors des 6 matches du tournoi olympique, Michael Olise a compilé 2 buts et 5 passes décisives sous les ordres de Thierry Henry. Ce parcours s'est achevé par une médaille d'argent décrochée le 9 août 2024 au Parc des Princes, après une finale disputée contre l'Espagne (3-5 après prolongation).

Sources indicate that au-delà de ce bilan chiffré, Thierry Henry qualifie Michael Olise de génie qu'il ne faut pas brider. Dans le podcast Kampo, l'ancien joueur d'Arsenal a ainsi développé son analyse sur le talent de son ancien joueur : « Michael, il est à part parce qu’il pense différemment. À un moment donné, les génies, il ne faut pas essayer de les comprendre. C’est un génie ? Ah, de très loin, très très loin. (…) Est-ce que tu vas, toi, dire à un peintre comment peindre ? Pourquoi tu veux bloquer un génie ? ».

« Il a haussé le ton » : Zinédine Zidane a secoué les Bleus !

📅 16 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (874 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Le10sport

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • It has been revealed that bousculée et imprécise lors du premier acte dimanche soir, l'équipe de France a affiché un tout autre visage après la pause face à la Turquie.
  • Recent findings suggest that dimanche 15 novembre, les Bleus disputaient la 6e et dernière journée de la Ligue des nations face à la Turquie au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux.
  • It has been revealed that dans le vestiaire tricolore, Zinédine Zidane a recadré ses joueurs, sans pour autant céder à une colère excessive.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that bousculée et imprécise lors du premier acte dimanche soir, l'équipe de France a affiché un tout autre visage après la pause face à la Turquie. Un sursaut salutaire provoqué par Zinédine Zidane, qui n'a pas hésité à hausser le ton dans le vestiaire.

Recent findings suggest that dimanche 15 novembre, les Bleus disputaient la 6e et dernière journée de la Ligue des nations face à la Turquie au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux. Trois jours après le revers concédé face à l'Italie à San Siro, premier accroc de l'ère Zinédine Zidane, les Tricolores se devaient de réagir. Toutefois, à la pause, le score restait nul et vierge (0-0), actant un dixième match de suite sans marquer lors du premier acte. Un manque d'efficacité chronique qui a fini par agacer le sélectionneur.

It has been revealed that dans le vestiaire tricolore, Zinédine Zidane a recadré ses joueurs, sans pour autant céder à une colère excessive. Le sélectionneur souhaitait corriger l'apathie collective et le manque d'agressivité à la perte du ballon constatés durant le premier acte. Une mise au point nécessaire pour relancer son équipe. Au micro de TF1 après la rencontre, le défenseur de Liverpool Jérémy Jacquet a ainsi dévoilé la teneur du discours : « Le coach nous a dit à la mi-temps qu’il trouvait qu’on n’était pas assez agressifs à la perte du ballon. On l’a bien rectifié en deuxième. […] Pour être honnête, il n’a pas gueulé, mais a haussé le ton sur nos axes de progression à la perte de balle. Pour lui, on pouvait faire mieux. Il trouvait qu’on gardait trop le ballon et voulait que l’on bouge plus. ».

According to recent reports, de son côté, le technicien tricolore a confirmé avoir bousculé ses troupes tout en restant mesuré, préférant insister sur les ajustements tactiques exigés sur la pelouse. « Ce n'est pas la défense. C'est tous ensemble. On doit aller presser tous ensemble et quand on ne presse pas, on se resserre tous ensemble. C'est des choses qu'on doit mettre en place. On a besoin de garder le ballon. On aime courir avec ballon, sans ballon, ce n'est pas notre truc. On l'a mieux en seconde période en jouant en deux touches. On doit le répéter. Les murs n’ont pas tremblé à la mi-temps. On a rectifié des choses et c’était mieux en seconde. La réaction était très bonne », a détaillé Zinédine Zidane sur TF1.

Sources indicate that en effet, la copie rendue au cours des quarante-cinq premières minutes a déçu le patron des Bleus. Malgré une possession de balle établie à 60 %, la France n'a jamais su emballer la rencontre, gaspillant de l'énergie à courir après le cuir tout en concédant de larges décalages. Le pressing tricolore s'est révélé particulièrement inefficace. Sur le plateau de TF1, Zinédine Zidane a ainsi exprimé sa frustration : « C'était l'objectif de se qualifier, en étant éventuellement premier. Par contre, sur le contenu, on peut être un peu perplexe, surtout dans notre pression en première mi-temps. Quand on ne voit pas certaines choses sur le terrain, on est un peu frustrés. C'est surtout dans la pression, parce qu'on laissait faire les décalages et on n'a pas été bons du tout dans notre pression. On a rectifié ça à la mi-temps et on a été meilleurs après. Ce sont des choses où on doit encore s'améliorer. Moi, je n'étais pas content, les joueurs non plus. Mais on a rectifié. ».

D'ailleurs, le sélectionneur a réitéré son agacement en conférence de presse d'après-match pour cibler ce dysfonctionnement inhabituel. Pour Zinédine Zidane, son équipe a été défaillante dans sa première ligne de récupération en concédant bien trop de liberté à l'adversaire : « Ce qui n’a pas été bon, c’est notre première pression. On l’a très bien fait sur les cinq autres matchs, même contre l’Italie. En revanche, ce soir, on a été défaillants, notamment en première mi-temps. On a laissé beaucoup trop d’espaces. On a rectifié le tir en deuxième mi-temps où on a été très bons dans l’utilisation du ballon. Même si on peut encore mieux faire, parce que j’ai des joueurs de qualité qui peuvent garder le ballon. Ce sont eux (les Turcs) qui doivent courir derrière le ballon », a insisté Zinédine Zidane.

Industry observers note that au retour des vestiaires, le discours du sélectionneur a porté ses fruits. Nettement plus agressifs et tranchants en jouant en deux touches de balle, les Bleus ont rapidement trouvé la faille sur un but contre son camp d'Emirhan Topçu (49e). Lancés, les Tricolores ont ensuite fait le break grâce à Éli Junior Kroupi (79e). La réduction du score tardive d'Abdülkerim Bardakcı (89e) n'a rien changé à l'problem de la rencontre (2-1). Une réaction salutaire.

Industry observers note that ainsi, ce succès combiné à la défaite de l'Italie contre la Belgique (1-4) permet à la France de terminer à la première place de sa poule. Les hommes de Zinédine Zidane valident officiellement leur qualification pour les quarts de finale du Final 8 de la Ligue des nations. Les Bleus connaîtront leur prochain adversaire lors du tirage au sort programmé le vendredi 20 novembre 2026 en Suisse, avant d'aborder cette double confrontation en mars 2027.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Au sortir de la victoire obtenue face à la Turquie dimanche soir à Bordeaux, Zinédine Zidane n'a pas pu débriefer la rencontre avec ses troupes dans le vestiaire. En raison des départs précipités des joueurs, le sélectionneur de l'équipe de France a dû faire l'impasse sur son discours d'après-match.

It has been revealed that dimanche 15 novembre 2026, l'équipe de France a conclu sa phase de groupes de Ligue des nations par un succès contre la Turquie (2-1), devant 42 000 spectateurs au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux. Lors de cette 6e et dernière journée, les Bleus ont marqué un premier but grâce à une réalisation contre son camp d'Emirhan Topçu à la 49e minute, puis un deuxième avec Éli Junior Kroupi à la 80e minute, avant la réduction du score turque par Abdülkerim Bardakcı à la 90e minute. Le coup de sifflet final a retenti à 22h38. Une fin de soirée agitée.

À 22h40, les Bleus ont effectué un timide tour d'honneur autour du rond central plutôt qu'autour du terrain, sans plusieurs cadres dont le capitaine Kylian Mbappé qui avait déjà quitté la pelouse. D'ailleurs, la distance entre les joueurs et les tribunes lors de ce tour d'honneur a provoqué quelques sifflets de supporters français déçus.

Industry observers note that en effet, les départs se sont enchaînés à toute vitesse. Kylian Mbappé a quitté le stade Atlantique à 22h53, soit exactement quinze minutes après le coup de sifflet final, plusieurs témoins évoquant un joueur très pressé. Rayan Cherki et Malo Gusto ont ensuite quitté le stade ensemble valise à la main, suivis par Eduardo Camavinga. Une course contre la montre.

Sources indicate that et pour cause, la fermeture avancée de l'aéroport de Bordeaux-Mérignac imposait un timing très serré. Plusieurs avions privés étaient ainsi prévus au décollage : un jet pour Milan à 00h05 et un autre pour Madrid à 00h12. De son côté, l'avion de la Fédération Française de Football a quitté la Gironde à 1h15.

Passés en zone d'interviews, Andy Diouf et Pablo Pagis ont tous les deux confirmé l'absence de discours de Zinédine Zidane dans le vestiaire. « On n’a pas fait de discours », a déclaré Andy Diouf devant les micros. De son côté, Pablo Pagis a détaillé la gestion du sélectionneur tricolore : « Il a laissé tout le monde tranquille ».

Zinédine Zidane n'a pas retenu ses joueurs pressés en raison de la fatigue et du calendrier très serré de ce rassemblement de novembre, qui comptait deux matches en 72 heures.

Au-delà de cette fin de soirée au pas de course dans les couloirs du stade bordelais, les Tricolores ont validé leur qualification. Le prochain rendez-vous des Bleus de Zidane est fixé du 25 au 30 mars 2027 pour les quarts de finale aller-retour de la Ligue des nations.

Latest Update: Chelsea's slump in form unpacked: The stars who badly need to step up from Emi Martinez to Cole Palmer, what defensive horror shows mean for Xabi Alonso's job security - and the players in line to leave in January

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 7 min read (1355 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~7 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 12:00 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 12:02 EST, 23 November 2026.
  • Chelsea are lurching towards a crisis after yet another loss in which they were bullied, this time by Leeds United.
  • That 4-1 hiding saw Xabi Alonso heckled, and his players booed at both half-time and full-time, arguably deservedly so for such a disastrous showing.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By KIERAN GILL, MAIL SPORT REPORTER.

Published: 12:00 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 12:02 EST, 23 November 2026.

Chelsea are lurching towards a crisis after yet another loss in which they were bullied, this time by Leeds United.

That 4-1 hiding saw Xabi Alonso heckled, and his players booed at both half-time and full-time, arguably deservedly so for such a disastrous showing.

It has led to tentative speculation around Alonso's future as Chelsea prepare to travel to Oliver Glasner's Nottingham Forest on Friday night, not to mention questions about where he is going wrong and how he might arrest his team's slump in form.

Here, Daily Mail Sport tackles all the burning challenges at Stamford Bridge...

In a recent development, chief among Chelsea’s problems is the fact they have conceded 20 Premier League goals this season. It is as many as they have scored at the other end. So, as much as we have enjoyed their freescoring forward line this season, so too must we criticise their disastrous defending.

We know Alonso can organise a defence. His Bayer Leverkusen side only conceded 24 goals when they won the Bundesliga as unbeaten champions in 2023-24. Chelsea are now on the verge of overtaking that total before we even hit December.

Liam Delap, their former striker now at Forest, will be desperate to add to that tally this Friday, too.

Xabi Alonso is coming under growing pressure, with his Chelsea side failing to back up their promising early-season form.

Levi Colwill was all at sea against Leeds as Chelsea shipped another four goals, taking their tally to 20 in 11 games.

This morning, I watched back all 20 of the goals that Chelsea have leaked this term. There have been so many individual mistakes.

Recent findings suggest that like on day one, in the 3-2 win at Fulham, when an out of position Robert Sanchez let in Josh King's shot. And when Levi Colwill missed a defensive header which should have been routine, which led to Gonzalo Garcia scoring.

Chelsea got rid of Sanchez after that game, but Emiliano Martinez has hardly helped shore up this defence, as was apparent in the 4-1 loss to Leeds, when Colwill and Co were again all over the shop.

Until they cut out the silly mistakes, it is hard to see Chelsea competing at the top end of the Premier League.

Every manager at every club is sackable. Nobody is immune. But that’s not to say Alonso is suddenly up for the chop at Chelsea. I haven’t heard anything which would suggest those inside the club think finding a fourth permanent manager in the year 2026 is the answer.

Let’s not forget the overwhelming optimism when news broke of Chelsea striking an agreement to hire Alonso. It was an hour or so after the club had lost the 2026 FA Cup final to Manchester City. Recently, I took a look at the comments section of the story I wrote that day. It was full of excitement from Chelsea fans, and anger from Liverpool supporters at missing out on him.

Anyway, I think it’s too soon for us to start talking about Alonso’s job. He is in a bad moment, obviously. A very bad moment. Losing at home to Tottenham Hotspur and Leeds is a complete no-no for any Blues boss.

The supporters are more likely to curse his name than chant it right now, and it is hard to identify the style Alonso wants, with few discernible patterns of play to Chelsea's football.

But let’s give the bloke a chance to get himself out of this jam as he heads into his 12th Premier League match.

Believe it or not, Chelsea don’t like changing managers mid-season if they can help it. Enzo Maresca resigned, exiting on January 1, 2026. Liam Rosenior was sacked, yes, but the club were effectively forced into that change as the players clearly gave up on him. Let’s see if Alonso can find some solutions.

Chelsea don’t like changing managers mid-season if they can help it and Alonso, remember, has only had 11 Premier League games in charge.

We’ve tried to coax a little anger out of Alonso at press conferences, practically encouraging him to have a pop at his players for how they are performing, but he tends to resist the urge.

He’s clearly a nice guy. However, a Chelsea source does tell me he’s different behind the scenes. We may not see it on the outside, but internally, he is perfectly capable of being fiery with the players.

According to recent reports, which I hope is the case. Because sometimes, it can feel as if these Chelsea players need a good kick up the backside, rather than being coddled.

Sources indicate that I wrote a piece after the 4-1 loss to Leeds about how superstars can be stroppy. It’s normal. They can be so good that when the game isn’t going their way, they show their sulky side.

In a recent development, palmer did that both during and after Saturday’s defeat. It was pretty poor from him to not want to go around applauding the fans who had bothered to stick around at full-time, even if there had been boos. An apology has been attributed to Palmer on social media, but that’s just another case of fake quotes being circulated.

For me, Palmer has to look at himself as much as anybody. It’s been too long since we’ve seen him try to take a match by the scruff of the neck.

Cole Palmer put in another quiet display against Leeds - he needs to start taking matches by the scruff of the neck.

WHAT HAPPENED WITH EMEGHA AFTER THE GAME?

In a recent development, striker Emmanuel Emegha started for the first time and scored for the first time in Chelsea’s 4-1 loss to Leeds. Then he exited Stamford Bridge.

We have seen players leaving the stadium on foot before. Videos of Palmer being surrounded by supporters while being escorted to his ride home occasionally crop up on social media.

Emegha had possessions stolen from his car while he was in a restaurant after the match and the incident has been reported to police. He was not harmed.

From a footballing point of view, I'd like to see Emegha start away at Forest this Friday.

Industry observers note that not that I’m aware. He’s been linked with Paris Saint-Germain and I had an email from a PR person this morning trying to push a loan to AC Milan or Roma as a possibility.

It has been revealed that alonso has given the fans what they wanted in the last few league games. He started Estevao against Manchester United, brought him on at half-time at Sunderland and started him against Leeds.

Estevao, clearly an exciting talent, could do with taking these opportunities to show why he deserves more of them.

Estevao has been given a chance to shine by Alonso in recent weeks but has failed to grab his opportunities.

I could see Malo Gusto leaving if there’s interest and Chelsea don’t keep demanding £75million, because it is hard to see who would spend that on him.

Gusto started in five of Alonso’s first six games in all competitions at the beginning of the campaign. Since then, he has been handed one start in eight, and that was in the Carabao Cup at Liverpool. Coming on as a substitute in the loss to Leeds, he tried and failed to play Brenden Aaronson offside and was then beaten by his man as the visitors made it 4-1.

I wouldn’t be surprised if a few other fringe players are linked with leaving in pursuit of game time ahead of January, such as Valentin Barco and Jamie Gittens, who is training again after his ankle injury.

Sources indicate that as for incomings, I don’t need to tell you that Chelsea are interested in Alex Scott of Bournemouth. Arsenal are, too, but the word is the Blues are still the frontrunners as we approach January. Whether Scott is what this team needs is another conversation.

Più squadre di Serie C, sfide secche e diritti TV: ecco le due ipotesi allo studio per il futuro della Coppa Italia.

In a recent development, la Coppa Italia potrebbe cambiare volto nelle prossime tre stagioni. Nel nuovo bando per i diritti audiovisivi pubblicato dalla Lega Serie A, con scadenza al 14 dicembre, compaiono infatti due diverse formule pensate per rilanciare un torneo spesso snobbato fino alle fasi finali. A scegliere quale adottare sarà il mercato televisivo: prevarrà il format legato all'offerta economica più alta ricevuta dai broadcaster, con il via libera dell'Assemblea.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

La prima opzione, il Format "A", conferma l'impianto attuale della competizione con 44 squadre al via. Prevede solo 4 club di Serie C nel turno preliminare e l'ingresso delle prime otto classificate della passata Serie A direttamente dagli ottavi di finale con il vantaggio di giocare in casa. Sul piano economico, la Lega ha fissato una richiesta minima di 54 milioni di euro a stagione, pari a 162 milioni complessivi nel triennio. Una soluzione già collaudata che mantiene stabile la struttura del torneo e il relativo valore d'asta per le emittenti interessate.

Il Format "B" allargherebbe il torneo a 56 squadre, portando a 16 i club di Serie C con priorità alle Seconde Squadre (Under 23) di Serie A. Tutte partirebbero subito tranne le prime otto di Serie A (dai sedicesimi), con 24 sfide secche al primo turno, possibili incroci immediati tra A e C e l'ipotesi del sorteggio per il fattore campo. Anche le semifinali sarebbero in gara secca, aggiungendo un turno senza aumentare le gare per le finaliste, mentre le Under 23 non potrebbero affrontare le rispettive Prime Squadre se non in finale. Qui la base d'asta sale a 61 milioni annui (183 milioni nel triennio), trasformando il format in una leva commerciale per i broadcaster.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to recent reports, ciblé par de vives critiques après la récente défaite du Brésil, Carlo Ancelotti a réagi ce lundi avec une fermeté inhabituelle. Le sélectionneur de la Seleção a sèchement répondu aux attaques de Romario, qui réclamait publiquement son départ immédiat.

La tension est montée d'un cran autour de la sélection brésilienne depuis le revers concédé face au Japon (3-2), samedi 14 novembre 2026, au Stade national de Singapour. Alors que les Japonais menaient rapidement grâce à Takefusa Kubo et Keito Nakamura, le doublé de Vinícius Júnior (33e, 75e) avait pourtant permis aux Auriverdes d'égaliser. Toutefois, le but concédé à Tatsuhiro Sakamoto (91e) dans le temps additionnel a scellé la défaite brésilienne.

Présent en conférence de presse d'avant-match à Singapour, Carlo Ancelotti a été invité à réagir aux attaques formulées par l'ancien attaquant de la Seleção. Le technicien italien a répondu en espagnol à l'ancien international. Une mise au point limpide. « C'est la liberté d'expression et, dans un pays démocratique, tout le monde peut avoir une opinion. Romario a donné la sienne, et tout le monde a le droit de dire des mensonges, des vérités ou des bêtises. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que Romario parle beaucoup, et il est dans son droit », a ainsi rétorqué l'entraîneur face aux journalistes.

Cette sortie directe démontre la volonté du sélectionneur de balayer la polémique alors que la pression médiatique s'accentue. Carlo Ancelotti n'a pas souhaité polémiquer davantage avec l'ancienne gloire du football brésilien, se contentant de souligner avec ironie l'omniprésence médiatique de son détracteur.

In a recent development, deux jours plus tôt, Romario n'avait pas mâché ses mots à la suite de la défaite concédée face à l'équipe nippone. L'ancien buteur brésilien avait réclamé la destitution immédiate du sélectionneur sur ses réseaux sociaux, estimant qu'Ancelotti ne disposait pas des qualités requises pour diriger le pays. « Ça suffit ! Prends tes affaires et va-t'en ! », avait notamment écrit Romario, très remonté contre l'entraîneur italien.

Au-delà de cette interpellation, Romario a tout de même reconnu les accomplissements passés de Carlo Ancelotti, qualifié d'« un des grands entraîneurs » en club, tout en appelant à son retour sur le Vieux Continent : « Retourne dans les clubs, où tu t'es fait un nom, car la sélection brésilienne ne peut pas continuer à prendre ce risque ». L'ancien international a également interpellé le président de la Confédération brésilienne de football (CBF), Samir Xaud, affirmant qu'il fallait désormais « le courage de prendre une décision ». Cette attaque fait suite à une fin de match sous haute tension contre le Japon, au cours de laquelle Carlo Ancelotti et l'attaquant Raphinha avaient été expulsés pour avoir protesté contre une faute présumée au départ de la troisième réalisation adverse.

Lucide quant au niveau affiché par ses joueurs sur le terrain, Carlo Ancelotti n'a éludé aucune question sur les difficultés actuelles de la Seleção. Lors de son point presse, le coach italien a dressé une autocritique sans concession sur le rendement de son groupe. « Je dois faire plus et je vais le faire. J'aime être ici, j'aime être dans la sélection nationale et je dois m'améliorer. Je dois faire plus pour que la sélection redevienne compétitive. Il y a longtemps que nous ne sommes plus compétitifs », a déclaré le technicien italien.

In a recent development, toutefois, le sélectionneur brésilien a insisté sur la nature amicale de cette rencontre et la nécessité de renouveler son effectif en vue des futures échéances. « C'est évident que c'est le moment des essais. Nous essayons de nouveaux joueurs, en commençant par Gabriel Bontempo, André, Jonathan Jesus... Ce sont des évaluations très positives, sans mentionner de noms. Nous espérons toujours bien jouer, mais il est incompatible d'essayer, de renouveler et d'avoir l'équipe prête. Nous continuons avec une grande confiance dans cette voie et nous nous testerons contre Singapour », a détaillé le sélectionneur brésilien.

Industry observers note that après ce premier revers en Asie, le Brésil doit désormais se remobiliser pour son second match amical de la trêve internationale, prévu le mardi 17 novembre 2026 au Stade national de Singapour face à Singapour. Une rencontre que Carlo Ancelotti devra observer loin de la pelouse : le technicien italien est suspendu de banc de touche suite à son expulsion contre le Japon et ne pourra pas diriger directement ses hommes au bord du terrain. L'équipe devra également composer sans son attaquant Raphinha, lui aussi sous le coup d'une suspension. Pour animer son secteur offensif face aux Singapouriens, Carlo Ancelotti a d'ores et déjà annoncé la titularisation du jeune avant-centre Endrick pour le match du mardi 17 novembre 2026.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that C'est une annonce majeure pour le football belge en ce lundi 16 novembre 2026. Sur son compte Instagram, Romelu Lukaku a officialisé son départ définitif de la sélection des Diables Rouges après seize années passées au plus haut niveau international.

According to recent reports, L'attaquant de 33 ans a surpris l'ensemble des observateurs au lendemain de la victoire de la Belgique face à l'Italie (4-1) en Ligue des nations, qui a validé la qualification des Diables Rouges pour les quarts de finale du tournoi. Dimanche 15 novembre 2026, Romelu Lukaku est resté sur le banc des remplaçants sans entrer en jeu, après avoir manqué le match précédent face à la Turquie en raison d'une légère blessure à la hanche. Pour accompagner son message d'adieu sur le réseau social, le joueur a publié une galerie photo retraçant son parcours international depuis ses débuts en mars 2010 à l'âge de 16 ans. Plusieurs coéquipiers emblématiques de la génération dorée, dont Axel Witsel et Thibaut Courtois, ont d'ailleurs salué publiquement sa carrière sous sa publication. Une page se tourne pour les Diables Rouges.

En quittant la sélection, Romelu Lukaku laisse un héritage statistique considérable. L'avant-centre se retire en effet en tant que meilleur buteur absolu de l'histoire de la sélection belge avec 94 buts inscrits en 135 sélections. Au niveau des apparitions, le joueur n'est devancé que par Jan Vertonghen (157 sélections) et Axel Witsel (140 sélections). Pilier de la sélection durant plus d'une décennie, il a disputé quatre phases finales de Coupe du monde (2014, 2018 avec une 3e place, 2022 et 2026) ainsi que trois Championnats d'Europe (2016, 2020 et 2024). Son dernier match officiel sous le maillot des Diables Rouges remonte ainsi au 5 octobre 2026 contre l'équipe de France en Ligue des nations, lors d'une défaite (1-4).

Industry observers note that cette annonce constitue d'ailleurs un revirement par rapport aux prepares initialement affichés par l'intéressé. En effet, l'attaquant avait affirmé en janvier 2026 que la Coupe du monde 2026 ne marquerait pas sa dernière compétition majeure avec la Belgique. La sélection des Diables Rouges a elle aussi tenu à rendre hommage à son avant-centre sur son compte officiel X, saluant un joueur qui a écrit un incroyable chapitre de l'histoire de l'équipe nationale.

La situation sportive de l'attaquant s'était toutefois compliquée lors des dernières semaines avec les Diables Rouges. Depuis la prise de fonction de Mark van Bommel comme sélectionneur en août 2026 en remplacement de Rudi Garcia, Romelu Lukaku a vu son temps de jeu diminuer au profit de Charles De Ketelaere. Resté sur le banc lors du récent succès face à l'Italie, le joueur a finalement choisi de renoncer aux prochaines échéances internationales de son pays. En effet, la Belgique disputera les quarts de finale de la Ligue des nations du 25 au 30 mars 2027, dont le tirage au sort est fixé au vendredi 20 novembre 2026 à Nyon.

Toutefois, cette retraite internationale ne met absolument pas un terme à sa carrière en club. Romelu Lukaku évolue sous les couleurs de Fenerbahçe depuis le mois d'août 2026 et reste concentré sur ses objectifs en Turquie. L'attaquant disputera ainsi son prochain match officiel le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 17h00 face à Kocaelispor en Süper Lig.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

There is an obligation on all of us, from supporters to pundits and journalists, to remain calm and measured about footballers as young as Max Dowman. But, my word, he does make it difficult. Arsenal’s 16-year-old sensation continues to sparkle whenever he steps on to the field, and he did so again with this superb display against Ipswich Town.

Industry observers note that "The hype will only continue to grow!"Max Dowman that is delightful! 👏 pic.twitter.com/UfFY1VSyXn.

At this rate, Arsenal supporters will be looking forward to Carabao Cup matches as eagerly as any Premier League or Champions League game, simply because it will be a chance to watch Dowman again. The forward’s age and inexperience means he is still used sparingly in those high-priority competitions. The League Cup, by contrast, may prove to be his domain over the coming months.

Dowman’s double at Portman Road made him just the second 16-year-old to score two goals in a game for a Premier League side. The first was Wayne Rooney, for Everton against Wrexham in 2002.

The two goals underlined why there is so much excitement around Dowman. The first was a demonstration of his prodigious dribbling ability, as he weaved through Ipswich’s defence and buried his shot with the weaker right foot. The second revealed his composure: a slotted finish, rolled in with ease.

According to recent reports, max Dowman nets his second of the game! 😍 pic.twitter.com/XRZ9GqZx3x.

According to recent reports, as Mikel Arteta approaches the point of signing a upcoming contract in north London, one wonders how much the idea of developing Dowman will excite him as he looks to the future. Which manager would not want to coach a player of such natural ability? Which manager would not want to see how good he could be? The same is true of Marli Salmon, the 17-year-old defender who also impressed on Tuesday night.

According to recent reports, “A joy to have him,” said Arteta of Dowman. “It’s remarkable. It’s something very natural for him. He can deliver those actions effortlessly, I would say. What we have to do is look after him. He is 16. You don’t see that in this league. In other leagues in Europe, that’s a totally different context.

“Having two teenagers playing for Arsenal at this level is so fulfilling. Because I’ve been there and just to be able to contribute to somebody’s career and dream, to be able to experience a game like tonight, is phenomenal. And yeah, medium and long term, we know that if they continue to develop in the way that they are, we are going to have two tremendous footballers.”.

"He was brilliant, he made the difference - we need to look after him" 🌟Mikel Arteta says Arsenal need to "be really cautious" with 16-year-old Max Dowman after he scored twice in Arsenal's 4-2 win over Ipswich 🔴 pic.twitter.com/1msJAEkK8z.

Recent findings suggest that dowman’s two goals, along with strikes by Noni Madueke and Mikel Merino, secured a comfortable victory for Arsenal against Premier League opponents. Ipswich scored a goal of their own, through Anis Mehmeti, but never seemed likely to cause the visitors too much bother. A late strike from former Arsenal player Chuba Akpom was only a consolation. “We found a way to fight back into it,” stated Gary O’Neil. “Losing by two goals to them isn’t a dreadful effort.”.

Sources indicate that dowman is already developing a trademark goal, of sorts. His first strike for the club, against Everton last season, came after he left an opponent face-down on the turf at the Emirates Stadium. He inflicted the same pain here upon poor Cédric Kipré, who tried to tackle the teenager in the seventh minute but ended up with a mouthful of grass.

Industry observers note that it was an image that encapsulated Arsenal’s dominance in the early exchanges, as was the sight of Madueke firing in the second. The chance came after Bruno Guimarães and Merino, majestic in midfield, had monstered Ipswich’s attempts to play out from the back. Merino was dominant throughout, winning tackles with steel and then spinning away opponents with style. “He’s unbelievable,” said Arteta.

Arsenal’s long-term relationship with the League Cup is not a particularly healthy one. For a club of their stature, it is a source of mild embarrassment that they have not won this competition since 1993. They came close last season, reaching the final at Wembley, but were defeated by Manchester City.

Given the depth of Arteta’s squad, Arsenal really should reach the final again. If this is a tournament for the B-team, at least in these early stages, then Arsenal probably have the best B-team in the country. They started this game without any of Bukayo Saka, Declan Rice, Martin Odegaard, and Kai Havertz but were still extraordinarily strong in midfield and attack.

Industry observers note that the only pre-match concern was their defence, which has been weakened by a couple of early-season injuries. Arsenal started with Salmon at centre-back and the teenager was in direct combat with the physical, sharp-elbowed threat of Ipswich striker Zian Flemming. He stood up to the challenge with determination and class.

According to recent reports, ipswich had made 10 changes following their victory at Crystal Palace at the weekend, which was an indication of where the Carabao Cup sits in their priorities. They were able to get into Arsenal’s penalty area but never gave the impression they could really hurt the Premier League champions, apart from when Mehmeti converted Jack Clarke’s low cross.

Akpom struck in the 91st minute to encourage O’Neil, but by then the game had been lost. Arsenal’s work, and indeed Dowman’s work, had been done.

On managing the hype that surrounds Dowman, Arteta stated: “What we have to do is look after him. He’s 16 years old, you don’t see that in this league. In other leagues in Europe, that’s a totally different context, but in this league, with the demands... We need to make sure that every time we throw him in it’s in the right context with the right preparation.”.

Arsenal have won the League Cup twice – in 1987 and 1993 – meaning eight clubs have better records, including Aston Villa (five titles), Tottenham Hotspur (four), Nottingham Forest (four) and Leicester City (three).

Their rather modest haul is a far cry from their record-setting 14 FA Cup titles. In the 33-years since Arsenal’s most recent League Cup triumph, the competition’s title sponsor has changed hands four times (kudos to anyone who can name all five!).

No team has scored more goals through substitutes in the Premier League than Ipswich, which is a nod to the promoted club’s depth and work in the summer transfer window.

In a recent development, it has meant that Gary O’Neil has had to leave established players out of match-day squads. “It was really tough leaving out Darnell [Furlong] and Anis [Mehmeti] from the squad [against Crystal Palace],” he said. “Doing that to good people is one of the toughest parts of the job. But I have faith in them, it’s just that everyone’s fit at the moment and we’ve had to recruit a strong squad to get us through an unbelievably challenging season.

“On Tuesday, whoever I pick, I have 100 per cent faith that they’re ready and that they’re going to represent what we do and how we go about it.”.

On Hincapie’s omission from the match-day squad:.

“Some players were carrying some fatigue, some little problems that we have to look after and some other players are available, fresh and in better conditions to play.

On Timber being left out of tonight’s squad:.

“Everything is fine, but obviously he has played much more than we would have wanted. He played 53 minutes [against Sunderland] after five months. I will need to look after him.”.

When asked if Arsenal will set up with a back three tonight:.

Sources indicate that alan Davies, the actor and comedian who is a famously passionate supporter of Arsenal, recently told a story about a charity event he once attended with former captain Tony Adams. Speaking on The Tuesday Club podcast, Davies stated Adams revealed his football philosophy to be: “You need seven.”.

In a recent development, the “seven” in question, Adams explained, are seven members of the team who are ready and willing to fight the opposition in the tunnel after the game. Once a team have those seven individuals, Adams mentioned, everything else flows from there.

According to recent reports, for much of the past two decades, Arsenal have not had seven. In some years in the latter stages of Arsène Wenger’s tenure, they probably did not even have three or four. But that has all changed in recent seasons under Mikel Arteta, to such an extent that the Premier League champions would now undoubtedly bring considerably more than seven combatants to any touchline scrap or tunnel bust-up.

Saturday’s gritty 2-0 victory away to Sunderland provided evidence that Arsenal have added two more of these characters to their squad this summer.

In a recent development, tonight will be a good test for young Marli Salmon, the 17-year-old defender who is the latest high-class graduate of the Arsenal academy. Arsenal have extremely high hopes for Salmon, who made four senior appearances last season. He could be in the centre of defence or at right-back tonight. I suspect Ipswich striker Zian Flemming might try to target Salmon with some physical challenges, especially in the air. Let’s see how he handles it.

Max Dowman confirmed himself last season, showing off his gilded footwork in impressive cameos off the bench. Who could forget that lung-busting run and goal against Everton?

Sources indicate that and while the 16-year-old winger featured in Arsenal’s pre-season, these will be his first minutes of senior football in the season proper. His only game time thus far has come in the Premier League 2 under-21s competition and he was not included in the match-day squad at the Stadium of Light on Saturday.

According to recent reports, when asked about Dowman after the victory at Sunderland, Arteta remarked: “I wish we could have him here, but we have the limitation with the numbers that we can have. He will have his chance, he will have his minutes and he will have to earn them like anybody else. We know the talent that we have, we know the players that we have there and we need to help him and find a way to make sure he continues to develop and help the team.”.

Although keeping Ipswich in the Premier League must be Gary O’Neil’s primary goal, he has insisted that the club will embrace opportunities in the cups.

According to recent reports, when asked how he would approach tonight’s tie, O’Neil mentioned: “We’ll have a strong side, we’ve worked our socks off in the transfer window to give ourselves a strong squad. Of course, a different level to Arsenal, but we’ll be strong on Tuesday and we’ll do our best to win the game.

“The club has worked so hard to have these moments and of course it’s a cup game, but to have Arsenal and Liverpool come to Portman Road a week or so apart is what everyone has worked so hard for in recent years, so we’re going to enjoy it, we’re going to have a right go and worst thing that can happen is we lose to Arsenal.”.

🔴 𝗧𝗘𝗔𝗠𝙉𝙀𝙒𝙎 ⚪️Introducing your Carabao Cup Gunners starting XI ✨🤝 @deel.

Industry observers note that good evening and welcome to our live coverage of the Carabao Cup third-round tie between Ipswich Town and Arsenal. Mikel Arteta’s side have won all six of their matches so far this season, but travel to Portman Road fresh off an incident-filled win over Sunderland which thrust officiating back into the spotlight after Ezri Konsa conceded a penalty having been – in Arteta’s words – “judo-rolled” by Dan Ballard.

After the match, the Arsenal manager said: “I watched [the incident] 20 times and I cannot find a way to understand how to even think to give a penalty in this situation or the way the VAR has to intervene. So I don’t know what to think, really. But I’m sad, that we have to discuss, after such a beautiful game, something at this level that has the gravity of that because that changes the course of the season and it can cost you the championship… This cannot happen.”.

Arteta may be pleased that VAR is not in use at this stage of the Carabao Cup, and all eyes will be on Peter Bankes who takes charge of tonight’s match against Ipswich.

This season Arsenal hope to arrest a startling League Cup record. It has been 33 years since they last lifted the trophy, during which time they have been runners-up seven times. Losing last year’s final will have also added fuel to Arsenal’s fire, and Arteta may resolve he must field a strong starting XI. In fact, he may not have much choice in his backline as Ben White has emerged as a serious injury doubt after picking up an injury at the Stadium of Light and may join Cristhian Mosquera and William Saliba on the treatment table. This would likely mean starting Jurriën Timber, who is only just returning from a long-term groin issue. There is more scope for rotation in advanced positions, with Noni Madueke, Viktor Gyokeres, Eberechi Eze and Mikel Merino contenders to start.

A 90th-minute Zian Flemming winner against Crystal Palace on Saturday helped Gary O’Neil’s Ipswich to their second win in four Premier League games, a feat they required 16 matches to achieve the last time they were in the top flight. Heavy investment into Ipswich’s squad has proved fruitful thus far, though in-form striker Emersonn is expected to sit out tonight having taken a knock at Selhurst Park.

Il tennista ha lasciato la struttura il 24 novembre 2026, intorno alle 16.50 locali, le 15.50 in Italia. È uscito in stampelle dopo l’intervento eseguito in mattinata dal professor Lasse Lempainen.

Recent findings suggest that lempainen ha eseguito un allungamento della bandelletta ileotibiale. Si tratta della soluzione meno invasiva e meno stressante per l’articolazione del ginocchio tra quelle descritte nell’articolo. Nelle settimane precedenti, Sinner e il suo staff avevano tentato senza successo una terapia conservativa.

Industry observers note that ad accompagnarlo c’erano, tra gli altri, il padre Hanspeter e il medico di fiducia Zangrillo. All’uscita dall’ospedale Sinner è apparso stanco, ma si è fermato per una foto con due fan prima di salire sul van e lasciare la struttura. È la prima foto del tennista dopo l’operazione.

Industry observers note that in un messaggio pubblicato su Instagram, Sinner ha spiegato il percorso che ha preceduto l’operazione: «Nei mesi scorsi, insieme al mio team, abbiamo cercato di curare l'infortunio evitando la chirurgia. Dopo alcuni progressi molto incoraggianti, sfortunatamente il mio ginocchio non ha risposto come desiderato, ed ecco perché oggi mi sono sottoposto a un'operazione minore per migliorare le condizioni della banda ileotibiale».

According to recent reports, il tennista ha poi rivolto il pensiero al ritorno in campo e ringraziato chi lo sostiene: «Mi manca moltissimo essere in campo, ora inizio il processo di recupero, sempre insieme alla squadra. Grazie a tutti per il supporto». Tra i primi ad augurargli una pronta ripresa c’è stato l’amico rivale Alex De Minaur. Per Sinner cominciano ora il riposo e la riabilitazione, con la speranza di lasciarsi alle spalle il periodo più complicato della sua carriera.

The World Cup RETURNS to America! FIFA reveals 2031 tournament hosts after historic four-country bid

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 10:23 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 13:19 EST, 23 November 2026.
  • The World Cup is set to return to America after FIFA awarded the 2031 women's tournament to a historic four-nation bid.
  • Following the success of the men's tournament this summer, the United States was revealed as one of the hosts of the women's edition in five years' time during a virtual meeting of FIFA's national associations on Monday.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By ISABEL BALDWIN, US ASSISTANT SPORTS EDITOR.

Published: 10:23 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 13:19 EST, 23 November 2026.

The World Cup is set to return to America after FIFA awarded the 2031 women's tournament to a historic four-nation bid.

Following the success of the men's tournament this summer, the United States was revealed as one of the hosts of the women's edition in five years' time during a virtual meeting of FIFA's national associations on Monday.

The US will co-host the global soccer extravaganza alongside Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica after the four countries' joint bid was awarded uncontested the 2031 tournament.

The selection marks a milestone for the Women's World Cup with the tournament being hosted across four nations for the first time in its history.

The last World Cup was co-hosted by multiple countries for the first time with the 2023 edition taking place across Australia and Upcoming Zealand.

This summer's men's World Cup was also co-hosted by the US with games taking place across the States, Canada and Mexico.

The World Cup is set to return to the United States for the 2031 women's edition of the event.

Spain are reigning champions after winning the Women's World Cup in 2023.

The United States Women's National Team are four-time winners in 1991, 1999, 2015 and 2019.

The 2031 tournament will also be the largest in the competition's history, featuring an expanded 48-team field and 104 matches for the first time.

'We are incredibly honored and excited to welcome the world to the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica for the 2031 FIFA Women's World Cup,' said US Soccer President Cindy Parlow Cone.

'This is a historic moment for our four countries, but the opportunity is much bigger than any one of us. Together with FIFA, we want to deliver the biggest and most impactful Women's World Cup in history and use its success to accelerate the growth of women's soccer around the world. Our ambition is to create a tournament that not only inspires millions of players, but helps give them the opportunities to play, grow and pursue their dreams.'.

Sources indicate that the selection marks the third time that the Women's World Cup has been awarded to the US with the country previously hosting the landmark 1999 and 2003 editions alone. The national team's tournament win in 1999 was the second of its four titles.

Meanwhile, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica will become first-time hosts at the historic tournament.

'This milestone furthers the continued belief that the best days of soccer in America are still ahead,' said U.S. Soccer CEO and General Secretary JT Batson.

In a recent development, 'We have an opportunity to use the momentum from the 2031 FIFA Women's World Cup to accelerate our ambitions for the future of soccer, from expanding access and participation to strengthening the pathways that develop the next generation of players. We are excited to work alongside our partners across the region to make this tournament a defining moment for women's soccer.'.

The U.S.-led 2031 project across the CONCACAF regional soccer body bid offers FIFA a choice of stadiums in 20 cities: 14 in the U.S., four in Mexico plus San José in Costa Rica and Kingston, Jamaica.

US Soccer President Cindy Parlow Cone stated the federation was honored to be selected.

The host selection of the 2035 Women's World Cup was awarded to a joint bid between England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales.

The host selection of the 2035 Women's World Cup was also revealed on Monday with the tournament being awarded to another joint bid between England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales.

It marks the first time that a World Cup has been hosted on the British Isles since the men's tournament in 1966 in England.

The United Kingdom bid joins England with Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales that offers a choice from 19 venues, including Wembley Stadium in London.

The winning candidates and FIFA president Gianni Infantino promised commercially successful tournaments - the first editions with 48 teams and 104 games - and to reinvest all that money in women's soccer.

Industry observers note that FIFA wanted these heavyweights of women's soccer to face no opposition without rival bids and so lead hosting the first expanded tournaments. That will bring parity with the men's World Cup which expanded to 48 teams this year in the US, Canada and Mexico.

The 2027 Women's World Cup will have 32 teams in Brazil.

Il centrocampista piace a Palladino, che lo ha già allenato alla Fiorentina; Bondo è l’alternativa per gennaio.

Sources indicate that danilo Cataldi è il primo nome nella lista del Bologna per rinforzare il centrocampo a gennaio. Secondo quanto riportato da Corriere dello Sport, L’ipotesi dipende però da due condizioni: che il giocatore abbia superato del tutto il problema fisico con cui ha convissuto negli ultimi mesi e che le richieste di Claudio Lotito per il suo cartellino non siano troppo alte. Il contratto del centrocampista con la Lazio scade a giugno. Se la pista non dovesse concretizzarsi, l’alternativa indicata è Warren Bondo.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

il Bologna considera Cataldi una soluzione gradita e fattibile. Il club punta ad acquistare un mediano alla riapertura del mercato di gennaio, una necessità nota già da agosto.

Sources indicate that L’interesse del Bologna per Cataldi non nasce ora. Gli uomini dell’area tecnica avevano già pensato di portarlo a Casteldebole nell’anno in cui il centrocampista della Lazio passò invece alla Fiorentina. In viola trovò come allenatore Raffaele Palladino e disputò una grande stagione.

Tra il tecnico e Cataldi c’è stima reciproca. Palladino sarebbe felice di allenarlo di nuovo e anche il centrocampista ha grande considerazione di lui. Giovanni Sartori e Marco Di Vaio, per il momento, non vogliono affrontare pubblicamente il tema del mercato. La fonte ritiene possibile che si siano già mossi per capire prima le intenzioni del giocatore e poi quelle della Lazio.

Per il Bologna, dunque, Cataldi resta la prima scelta, a condizione che il guaio fisico sia completamente alle spalle e che l’eventuale trattativa con Lotito sia sostenibile. Il centrocampista ha 32 anni e arriverà a scadenza contrattuale a giugno.

It has been revealed that se non dovessero esserci le condizioni per arrivare a Cataldi, il Bologna guarda a Warren Bondo. Il centrocampista è attualmente fuori rosa al Milan, dopo aver trascorso il campionato passato nella Cremonese. Anche lui ha già lavorato con Palladino, ai tempi del Monza.

It has been revealed that rispetto a Cataldi, Bondo è un classe 2003 e non occuperebbe un posto in lista. I due profili hanno inoltre un elemento in comune: conoscono il campionato italiano. Palladino e il Bologna cercano rinforzi che non debbano impiegare tempo per adattarsi alla realtà del calcio italiano.

Recent findings suggest that per quanto possibile, lo stesso criterio guiderà la ricerca di giocatori destinati agli altri reparti. Il discorso è più complicato soprattutto per gli attaccanti: in Italia, chi dispone di profili affidabili tende a trattenerli oppure chiede cifre che il Bologna non è disposto a spendere.

Spurs finally score... but still lose

📅 16 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 25 min read (4999 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~25 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Tottenham Hotspur, the team with more zeroes than an England Ashes batting collapse, found the back of the net but still frustration persists for Roberto De Zerbi.
  • It could have been something different.
  • Sources indicate that “I think this is five or six games we have been for sure not lucky,” De Zerbi lamented, but sympathy did not extend too far.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

They scored. Would you believe it? Tottenham Hotspur, the team with more zeroes than an England Ashes batting collapse, found the back of the net but still frustration persists for Roberto De Zerbi.

It could have been something different. The sight of the Italian dashing down the touchline in hailstones, grabbing his head in disbelief in the final seconds, showed this was not a straightforward tale of misery but, ultimately, the misery endures.

Sources indicate that “I think this is five or six games we have been for sure not lucky,” De Zerbi lamented, but sympathy did not extend too far. Liverpool deservedly moved into the next round of the Carabao Cup, the gloss on Andoni Iraola’s most enjoyable night provided by Dominik Szoboszlai’s goal-of-the-season contender.

THAT'S MAGNIFICENT! 💥🔴Outrageous strike from Dominik Szoboszlai 👏👏👏 pic.twitter.com/meQ7nilsz6.

Liverpool were abject against Fulham on Saturday but with 10 changes to the starting line-up, infused with the exuberance of novices Rio Ngumoha and the terrific Lewis Koumas, Iraola’s team were invigorated and only a lapse of concentration enabled Tottenham to make a fist of it.

Yes, they went down swinging, as their noisy fans demanded. But carelessness cannot be excused and while De Zerbi complained about bad luck, a bad miss from Lucas Bergvall in the 10th minute was the fork in the road for the tie. Tottenham stalled and Liverpool never looked back.

Sources indicate that “We have to shoot more times and we have to shoot better,” De Zerbi harrumphed. “We have to finish better the clear situations. We are sorry for the result, disappointed and frustrated. I think it was unfair but we have to be stronger in these unlucky moments.”.

Recent findings suggest that rather than fizzing his drive into the net, Bergvall succeeded only in firing straight at Giorgi Mamardashvili, when he had the whole target in front of him. It was, in all fairness, a brilliant save but he should never have been allowed to make it.

Sources indicate that major save from Giorgi Mamardashvili! 💪Lucas Bergvall is denied by the Liverpool goalkeeper. pic.twitter.com/fKUbfGLMku.

Recent findings suggest that the miss changed the atmosphere, as suddenly Liverpool grasped the need to be competitive. At the heart of it all were Ngumoha, James McConnell, Trey Nyoni and Koumas, the last-named a nuisance to Tottenham’s defenders in the way a wasp is to picnickers on a summer’s afternoon.

It has been revealed that for all the money that has been lavished by this club over the past 14 months, the one thing that the locals buy into more than anything is the basics done properly: hard work, tackling, a refusal to take second best. Iraola did not want Koumas to go anywhere this summer and it was obvious why.

In a recent development, “I see him training every day,” Iraola said. “He knows very clearly what he needs to do, what the team needs. And also the energy he highlights is contagious for the rest. When you see the runs up front, giving everything, you are kind of forced to go behind and use the same intensity levels.”.

Simple tenacity enabled Liverpool to get back on an even keel and laid the foundation for them to take the lead. It was a terrific goal, started with a raking pass from Joe Gomez that Cody Gakpo controlled instantly on his chest before scuttling inside and inviting Ngumoha to charge forward.

Whether it was the winger or Destiny Udogie, who was sliding to make a challenge, that ended up playing the ball to Alexis Mac Allister is immaterial, all that mattered is that the Argentine effortlessly placed his shot into the top corner, leaving Martin Dubravka planted and helpless.

Recent findings suggest that pick that out!! 🇦🇷Alexis Mac Allister hits a beauty into the roof of the net 🔴 pic.twitter.com/G7OT27CA8P.

Recent findings suggest that is Mac Allister playing with a point to prove? Possibly, given his comments about not being offered a newly introduced contract last week. Will Iraola be bothered? Not in the slightest. All he wants is top players at the top of their game and Mac Allister is climbing towards the levels he indicated two years ago.

What De Zerbi would do to have a player in such form, but Tottenham are a skittish bunch, not the type of team who respond well in the face of adversity and their head coach, dressed in black with his oversized white trainers, regularly shook his head in exasperation.

His mood was not helped just before the interval, when Mohammed Kudus blasted over from eight yards following a zipped-in cross from Udogie, but he would not have called it truthfully if he had suggested Tottenham deserved parity at that stage. Soon Liverpool’s advantage would be doubled.

The buffer they sought arrived in the 54th minute and, again, it was another genuinely attractive goal, with possession being kept until it sped up when Ngumoha scurried forward, found Milos Kerkez, who played it to Mac Allister, who in turn gave Gakpo the opening he craved.

His touch was excellent, his finish was even better and away in the distance Iraola rattled his fists in delight. That is two goals and four assists to start the campaign for the Dutchman and yet Liverpool were ready to sell him to Manchester City two weeks ago. What on earth were they thinking?

Ruthless!! 🔥Cody Gakpo doubles Liverpool's lead against Spurs 🔴 pic.twitter.com/qlaaynMuwM.

In a recent development, from that point, it seemed inconceivable that Liverpool would finish living on their nerves, but De Zerbi’s decision to introduce Andy Robertson – given a hero’s reception on his first return to Anfield – and Mateus Fernandes wrestled back some impetus. There was also a significant helping hand.

Unsurprisingly, Andy Robertson gets a great reception from the Liverpool fans on his return to Anfield 👏 pic.twitter.com/uNM6A00k5F.

Mamardashvili had made some important saves, including one from Kudus that he celebrated on his own, but he is vulnerable at set-pieces and Fernandes’s looping corner gave Conor Gallagher the easiest headed opportunity in three years to change the dynamic.

According to recent reports, spurs have scored! ⚪️Conor Gallagher brings Roberto De Zerbi's side back into the game! pic.twitter.com/52zSCqClw4.

“We were under pressure at the end, but I don’t think we were nervous,” Gakpo noted.

It has been revealed that he was right. Try as they might, Spurs could not quite get the opening they needed and as they chased in vain, Szoboszlai administered the final blow in mesmerising fashion, thrashing a bouncing ball into the Kop net from 30 yards. And as De Zerbi realised in the sodden conditions, with Tottenham it never rains. It only pours.

"A Steven Gerrard type of strike" 😍Jamie Redknapp and Conor Coady analyse Dominik Szoboszlai's wondergoal 🪄 pic.twitter.com/h9QTuP8lZc.

🗣️ "The young players give us energy" 💪Andoni Iraola is very pleased with the way the Liverpool youngsters played after beating Spurs 3-1 at Anfield 👏#ITVFootball | @Carabao_Cup | @markpougatch | @Robbie9Fowler pic.twitter.com/bHjOrmccH2.

🗣️"Szoboszlai scores A LOT OF BANGERS"😂Needless to say Cody Gakpo was really impressed with Dominik Szoboszlai's goal for Liverpool 👏#ITVFootball | @LFC | @Carabao_Cup | @gabrielclarke05 pic.twitter.com/O3bs6Y9M2p.

"They've done themselves proud!" 👏Conor Coady on Lewis Koumas performance for Liverpool 🔥 pic.twitter.com/3JGkuY7Eye.

Andrew Robertson received a great reception from the Anfield crowd whilst warming up, when he came on and now at full-time. He catches up with old teammates as he heads off in the pouring rain, applauding the Liverpool fans.

There is the final whistle at Anfield and Liverpool book their place in the fourth round of the League Cup courtesy of a 3-1 win over Tottenham. Andoni Iraola’s side scored three stunning goals to seal their progression.

Recent findings suggest that mamardashvili does well to save from a deflection, like he did a few minutes ago. Mamardashvili did not cover himself in glory for Tottenham’s goal but has made some great saves tonight.

According to recent reports, oh my word! The Hungarian loves a screamer and this is another to add to the list. It is similar to a goal Suarez scored at The Kop End against Norwich a number of years ago. Szoboszlai chests it down and from nearly 30 yards out smashes across the ball. The ball flies into to the top corner, always going away from Dubravka, and Szoboszlai celebrates in front of The Kop. A quite incredible goal.

According to recent reports, THAT'S MAGNIFICENT! 💥🔴Outrageous strike from Dominik Szoboszlai 👏👏👏 pic.twitter.com/meQ7nilsz6.

There will be four added minutes at Anfield.

Savio has an effort from the right side of the box but drags his shot wide of the far post.

In a recent development, liverpool counter with Mamardashvili’s long ball forward for Isak, who gets the better of Gray on the left side of the box. Isak gets his shot away and the ball appeared to hit Tosin’s arm but the penalty is not given. Replays show it did hit Tosin’s arm and he is lucky there is not VAR tonight as that could well have been overturned.

Solanke is on for Tottenham in place of Tel as the visitors have a corner out on the right. Tottenham take it short before the delivery is swung in and headed away by Gakpo as the rain comes thrashing down again at Anfield.

According to recent reports, tottenham keep it alive and Marmoush has an effort from the left side of the box. It deflects off Araujo and Mamardashvili makes a stunning save.

Szoboszlai should bury a guilt-edge chance inside the Tottenham penalty area but his effort is saved. There was a suspicion of offside against Szoboszlai but the flag did not go up. Szoboszlai was being played onside by quite some way by Gray so a huge missed opportunity.

That is superb one-vs-one defending from Jacquet. The ball is played down the left channel but Jacquet gets the better of Marmoush.
